sloka: त्वरमाणैर्महाकयैरेकविम्शतिरेव च ।चतुर्थेन तथा चाह्ना द्वाविम्शतिरथापि वा ॥६-२२-६९॥।।
transliteration: tvaramāṇairmahākayairekavimśatireva ca ।caturthena tathā cāhnā dvāvimśatirathāpi vā ॥6-22-69॥।।

translations.english: There upon at once Vanaras of great speed built twenty two yojanas on the fourth day.
